content.title: Coachella 2026: Karol G Creates History At Coachella; How Much Was She Paid For The Show?
content.text: Karol G Coachella News: The Coachella stage lit up in style as Karol G delivered one of the most talked-about performances of Coachella 2026, closing out the first weekend with unmatched energy. Headlining Day 3, the global Latin music sensation turned the stage into a high-voltage spectacle. Discover moremoviesmusicConcerts & Music FestivalsMusic & AudioMoviesMovieArts & Entertainment Coachella 2026: Karol G Creates History At Coachella Music Festival Karol G is dominating headlines worldwide after her sensational Coachella 2026 set, which has quickly turned into one of the festival's biggest talking points. The Colombian hitmaker delivered a power-packed two-hour performance on April 12, taking charge of the main stage and bringing the first weekend to a grand close. In a landmark moment for Coachella, she became the first Latina artist to headline in its 25-year history, marking a significant cultural milestone. The official Coachella YouTube livestream of Karol G's headlining set began at 10:26 PM PT, around 30 minutes behind schedule. Despite the delay, her performance instantly took over the internet, with clips going viral across platforms like Twitter and Instagram, further amplifying the global buzz around her show. Karol G Coachella Performance: How Much Did Karol G Charge For The Show? Karol G has kept her Coachella 2026 earnings under wraps, with no official confirmation about her fee so far. However, industry buzz suggests that the global superstar may have taken home an estimated paycheck between $5 million and $10 million, as per a Bollywood Shaadis report, for her headline performance. Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 Dates & Lineups The second weekend of Coachella 2026 is set to take place from April 17 to April 19, bringing back the same star-studded lineup. Fans can expect the headliners to return for another round of high-energy performances, recreating the magic of Weekend 1 on the iconic festival stage.
